_about: Evidence for remediate_catalog.flag_propaganda (Decision 149). Flagged items are never recommended (Home, hero, More Like This, channels, Top Shelf, Tonight, Surprise, social) and stay reachable by Search, Detail and Browse. Owner, 2026-09-28: "All true propaganda should be hidden from recommendations, but avaialble via search." Every entry names a source a reader can open. Owner, 2026-09-28, on two films seen headlining Home: keep them off recommendations too ("Keep off recommendations") — named one by one in `add`, each with its source, never by a rule.

vorbehaltsfilme.note: Nazi-era films the Friedrich-Wilhelm-Murnau-Stiftung releases only for supervised screenings because of their propaganda content. Matched on title and year (within two years).
